basic_info.description: Located in the heart of the Excelsior neighborhood, this charming home presents an incredible opportunity for its next owner to bring their vision to life. Just one block from Excelsior Playground Park and moments from the natural beauty of McLaren Park, this location offers both urban convenience and outdoor recreation at your doorstep.  Step inside to a welcoming living room, where a large front-facing window fills the space with natural light. The room's original built-in hutch adds character and charm. Adjacent to the living area, the first bedroom enjoys abundant sunlight, creating a cozy retreat. The spacious kitchen offers ample storage and seamlessly connects to the second bedroom. Toward the back of this level, you'll find a full bathroom with a shower-over-tub.  Step out onto the back deck, an ideal space for BBQs and outdoor gatherings while the exterior staircase leads down to a deep, sun-drenched backyard, perfect for gardening or relaxation. Below, the lower level features a generous storage area, and a bonus family room and office space. Don't miss this great opportunity to create a home that perfectly suits your style in one of the city's most vibrant neighborhoods.
